event.listen_im.interface_reason: Reviewed IM event facade: it deterministically maps kind/events to public personal EventKeys, resolves one natural user/chat target with the shared typed resolver, then delegates one single- or multi-event invocation to the existing subscription, bus, ready-marker, NDJSON, rollback, cancellation, and cleanup lifecycle.
event.listen_im.review_reason: Reviewed against every kind/event mapping and conditional target branch, structured ambiguity/no-match behavior, same-profile read resolution, all-or-nothing multi-subscription preparation, dry-run resolution parity, and reuse of runPersonalEventConsume. It does not create a second event system or expose unverified group lifecycle mappings.

event.consume.interface_reason: Reviewed composite workflow: the command creates or reuses a remote personal-event subscription and coordinates the local event bus and Stream consumer; no single pinned RPC represents the workflow.

event.list.interface_reason: 命令读取 CLI 内置的个人事件目录，不绑定 pinned MCP RPC

event.schema.interface_reason: 命令读取 CLI 内置的个人事件 payload 定义，不绑定 pinned MCP RPC

event.status.interface_reason: Reviewed composite workflow: the command reads the remote personal-event subscription control plane and combines it with local bus and consumer state; no single pinned RPC represents the result.

event.stop.interface_reason: Reviewed composite workflow: the command deletes remote personal-event subscriptions, interrupts local consumers, updates local state, and may stop the local bus; no single pinned RPC represents the workflow.
event.stop.review_reason: Runtime already requires --yes (or --dry-run preview) before cancelling subscriptions / stopping the bus; align Schema safety and runtime_gate with that gate.
